findings.title: Runtime acceptance claims lack retained assertion-level execution evidence
evidence: docs/reviews/phase-1-m1/stage-6/GEN07_REVISION_03_CANDIDATE_FREEZE.json:82-96,116 — runner/verifier are external inputs, not included in repository entries; stdout/checkpoints were not retained.
docs/evidence/phase-1-m1/stage-6/gen07-revision-03/runtime-acceptance-reconciliation.json:18-25 — exit code 0 is recorded, but structured checkpoints were not persisted and stdout was not retained.
docs/evidence/phase-1-m1/stage-6/gen07-revision-03/runtime-acceptance-receipt.json:24-37 — API-path and sign-in/MFA/session outcomes are asserted in the receipt.

docs/evidence/phase-1-m1/stage-6/gen07-revision-03/runtime-acceptance-reconciliation.json:35-58 — read-only DB checks reconcile persisted state and immutability, not the transient HTTP/auth responses.
findings.scenario: A reviewer treats the receipt’s HTTP 409, authentication/MFA, and session assertions as directly observed execution output. The recorded zero exit code and read-only state reconciliation corroborate completion and persisted state, but do not independently expose those transient assertion results; the raw assertion-bearing runner is not part of the frozen candidate.
findings.consequence: The runtime acceptance claims for key Stage 6 security and publication behavior cannot be independently confirmed from the frozen evidence. This evidence gap blocks GREEN.
findings.requiredCorrection: Keep this candidate NO_GO. In a separately authorized successor, retain redacted machine-readable assertion checkpoints or equivalent direct execution evidence, bind it into the indexed evidence and freeze, and obtain a fresh independent review.

findings.title: CI receipt claims a final marker absent from its indexed log
evidence: docs/evidence/phase-1-m1/stage-6/gen07-revision-03/ci-receipt.json:15-20 — declares the log’s finalMarker as “PHASE_1_M1_STAGE_6 PASS”.
docs/evidence/phase-1-m1/stage-6/gen07-revision-03/ci.log:8657 — ends with CANONICAL_CI_EXIT_CODE=0; the retained 8,657-line log contains no occurrence of the claimed final marker.
docs/reviews/phase-1-m1/stage-6/GEN07_REVISION_03_PRE_FREEZE_VALIDATION.json:27-34 — repeats the PASS marker claim and binds the CI log hash.
findings.scenario: A reviewer relies on the receipt’s marker field as proof that the retained canonical CI log contains the final PASS marker, although the indexed log records only exit code 0 at its end.
findings.consequence: The receipt overstates what the retained CI log directly proves, weakening the auditability of the canonical CI PASS claim.
findings.requiredCorrection: Preserve evidence that actually contains the marker, or correct the receipt/validation to distinguish exit-code and gate evidence from a marker not present in the retained log. Do not rerun CI without separate authorization.

reviewSummary: Freeze integrity passed and the final scan is PASS, but the acceptance assertion evidence is insufficient for GREEN. The CI receipt also overclaims a final marker absent from the retained log. The reviewer found no actionable source-level Preview/publish, authorization, persistence, migration, or deployment-contract defect in the reviewed paths. No files were modified; no CI, deployment, network, database, or CT access occurred.
